# Model evaluation — AgroAdvisor-ET response-ratio model

**Generated by `model/evaluate.py`; every number in this file comes from `model/artifacts/model_eval.json`. Do not edit by hand.**

- Protocol: `grouped-cv-10x5-deterministic` — 10 repetitions x 5 grouped folds
- Folds: `data/processed/cv_folds.csv` (deterministic, pure-Python; see `pipelines/dataset/assign_folds.py`)
- Data: 8,664 rows, 337 studies, grouped by `Study_No_`
- Direction semantics: `recommend.DIRECTION` (import recommend)
- Every figure below is **mean ± sd across the repetitions**. The sd is the fold-choice uncertainty, which is exactly what a single `GroupKFold` pass hides.

## 1. Protocol comparison — what the R² means

| protocol | R² | reading |
|---|---:|---|
| **Grouped CV by study (primary, honest)** | **0.251 ± 0.015** | no study appears on both sides; this is what a new pin gets |
| Random 5-fold (leakage ablation) | 0.511 ± 0.004 | rows of the same study in train and test — **not skill** |
| Ceiling: (study, practice, indicator) means, in sample | 0.563 | an oracle knowing the exact cell; the rest is replicate noise |
| Ceiling: (study, indicator) means, in sample | 0.493 | the study (site/season) effect alone |
| Ceiling: (practice, indicator) means, in sample | 0.386 | practice effect with no study information |

Reading: the random-split figure is leakage, not skill. Even an oracle that knows the exact (study, practice, indicator) cell reaches only 0.56, so ~44% of the target is within-cell replicate noise that nothing can predict. A study-blind R² near 0.25 should be read against that ceiling, not against 1.0.

## 3. Ranking skill of the selected model

This is the headline: the product ranks practices for one pin, so ranking skill matters more than row-level R². Scored inside (study, indicator) cells comparing >= 3 distinct practices, after direction alignment.

| metric | value | chance / reference |
|---|---:|---|
| cells scored | 68 | of 337 studies x 7 indicators |
| Spearman rho (mean over cells) | 0.39 ± 0.03 | 0 = no ordering skill |
| Spearman rho (median over cells) | 0.51 ± 0.03 | |
| top-1 hit rate | 52.2% ± 3.1% | chance 27.5% |
| top-half hit rate | 77.1% ± 2.3% | chance ~50% |
| pairwise concordance (C-index) | 0.70 ± 0.02 | 0.50 = coin flip, over 584 pairs |

**Direction (beneficial vs harmful), reported honestly:**

| metric | value |
|---|---:|
| base rate of beneficial observations | 73.1% |
| accuracy | 74.6% ± 0.9% |
| balanced accuracy | 0.608 ± 0.013 |
| ROC-AUC | 0.682 ± 0.009 |

Plain accuracy is near the base rate, so it says nothing on its own; balanced accuracy and AUC are the figures to quote.

## 4. Per-indicator and per-source (selected model)

| indicator | n | R² | RMSE | confidence |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| SOM content | 111 | -0.718 ± 0.492 | 0.361 ± 0.050 | low |
| biomass yield | 1525 | 0.078 ± 0.044 | 0.556 ± 0.013 | medium |
| income | 208 | -0.150 ± 0.100 | 0.723 ± 0.031 | low |
| runoff | 359 | -0.138 ± 0.064 | 0.867 ± 0.024 | low |
| soil loss | 296 | -0.001 ± 0.050 | 1.024 ± 0.026 | low |
| water use efficiency | 255 | -0.077 ± 0.068 | 0.606 ± 0.019 | low |
| yield | 5910 | 0.100 ± 0.026 | 0.498 ± 0.007 | medium |

| source | n | R² |
|---|---:|---:|
| CSA | 1414 | 0.374 ± 0.023 |
| ERA | 7250 | 0.184 ± 0.015 |

Confidence flags are derived from the **lower end of the mean ± 1 sd band** of the per-indicator grouped R² across the repetitions (mean − sd >= 0.10 high, >= 0 medium, else low): a flag is granted only when the whole band clears the cut-off, so it neither flips with fold luck nor rests on a coin-flip margin.

> **Flags sitting on a threshold.** Repeated CV removes fold luck, but it cannot decide a flag whose R² lands on the cut-off. For these indicators the margin is a small fraction of their own sd, so the flag is effectively undetermined and is a policy choice about where the thresholds sit, not a measurement:
>
> | indicator | mean R² | sd | threshold | margin | margin / sd |
> |---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
> | soil loss | -0.0012 | 0.0503 | 0.00 | -0.0012 | 0.02 |
> | yield | 0.1004 | 0.0264 | 0.10 | +0.0004 | 0.01 |

## 6. Feature ablation (report only — NOT adopted)

Adding `lgp_days`, `soil_ph`, `soil_soc` to the 13 serving features. These are present in the dataset and in the raster stack but are explanation-only in `recommend.py`.

| feature set | R² | Spearman rho |
|---|---:|---:|
| 13 features (current) | 0.251 ± 0.015 | 0.39 ± 0.03 |
| + lgp_days + soil_ph + soil_soc | 0.251 ± 0.016 | 0.40 ± 0.05 |

Gain: **+0.0000 R²** (within one sd of the current feature set — no evidence of gain). Not adopted: it would change the serving feature contract that `recommend.py` depends on, which is a separate decision.

## 7. Reproducing this

```bash
python pipelines/dataset/assign_folds.py    # only if cv_folds.csv is missing
python model/train_model.py                 # full protocol + artefacts
python -m pytest model/test_evaluate.py pipelines/dataset/test_assign_folds.py -q
```

The fold file is committed, so the split is identical on every machine. Model internals can still differ slightly between library versions; the sd columns show how much fold choice alone moves each figure.
